what: Per-case outcomes of every evaluation pass the paper reports: one row per LIBERO-Plus case, 10,030 cases per file, one trial per case.
protocol_note: protocol_id above is the protocol of the pi0.5 passes. Each file carries its own protocol_id: the OpenVLA-OFT+ and FLUX-3 passes use their own evaluator settings, so their scores do not compare with the pi0.5 files.

fields.suite: LIBERO suite: libero_spatial, libero_object, libero_goal or libero_10
fields.axis: LIBERO-Plus perturbation factor (category) of the case
fields.level: LIBERO-Plus difficulty level of the case (1-5)
fields.success: true when the episode reached the task's success predicate within its step limit
fields.steps: simulator steps of the episode, settle steps excluded

scores: seven_axis_mean_pct: unweighted mean of the 7 axis success rates, in percent of the axis's cases; recomputed from these rows when the file was built, and by recompute.py
